description: Oak is a genus of approximately 600 species in the beech family, Fagaceae. Oaks are grown for their strong, hard woods and their acorns, which are edible after the tannins are leached out. Oaks can be shrubs or trees as tall as 24 m. More growing information is available in individual species entries.

companions.notes: openfarm-crops-rescue lists this as a companion without indicating polarity; assumed 'good' per common convention

data_sources.notes: edible_parts=['seeds'] inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Oaks produce acorns, which are seeds that can be eaten after processing.

is_edible corrected from false to true (GitHub issue #165): edible_parts=['seeds'] was already populated, a direct contradiction with is_edible=false, and no is_toxic flag or toxicity_notes explained the discrepancy - a full-dataset audit found this affecting 120 plants (grown from an earlier 25-plant spot-check once backlog #133's edible_parts backfill widened coverage), all of them unambiguous real food/herb/fruit crops.
